label: Storage
description: Records of a shape, kept behind a connection. A feature declares a store -- which shapes it persists, under which collection names, keyed by which field -- and its data graphs read and write those records through store.port.json, naming the store and the collection and nothing else: the collection is where the record type is written down. This plugin says what may be asked of a store; how one is kept is an engine plugin's business, and @storage speaks no engine's language and carries no driver. Every operation is an effect: it lives in a data graph and is listed in the feature's effects.
